periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, with the primary axis of each patch angled approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the center of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the vertical dimension significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward taper toward the ventral-lateral aspect of the cheeks, showing a distinct extension below the eye center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the dark band encompasses the entire shoulder and upper thoracic region, extending to approximately one-third of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement, with the ear regions situated on the upper-outer corners of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, highly convex, and semi-circular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow discoloration visible on the white fur of the lower thoracic and abdominal regions compared to the bright white facial fur.
